subgoals.description: Capture a fresh RGB image from the monocular camera to get the most current view of the workspace.
Analyze the captured image using a visual model to detect and determine the location of the 'strawberry' to be picked and the 'box' for placement.
Plan the robot's full trajectory to pick the detected strawberry and place it into the box, ensuring a safe and efficient path.
Estimate the precise 3D grasp, approach, and place poses for the detected strawberry using its bounding box information.
Move the robot's end-effector to the approach pose above the strawberry using joint-space motion for smoother transition.
Provide live commentary to the operator about the robot's current action of approaching the strawberry.
Descend linearly from the approach pose to the precise grasp pose on the strawberry.
Activate the pneumatic suction gripper to firmly grasp the strawberry.
Lift the strawberry vertically after grasping it, moving back to the safe approach pose for clearance.
Inform the operator that the strawberry has been successfully grasped and is now being moved towards the target.
Move the robot's arm, holding the strawberry, to the target box location using joint-space motion.
Provide live commentary indicating the robot is at the placement location and about to release the object.
Deactivate suction to release the strawberry gently into the box.
Inform the operator that the strawberry has been successfully released into the box.
Visually verify that the strawberry has been successfully placed inside the box as intended.

assumptions: A strawberry is visible and detectable in the current camera view.
A box is visible and detectable as the target placement location.
The robot's end-effector is equipped with a functional suction gripper.
The first detected object in the `analyze_scene` output will correspond to the strawberry for grasp pose estimation.
